rationale: Description requires BOTH (a) legs crossed at knee and (b) hands stacked on the TOP (crossed-over) knee. Currently legs do not cross (hipAbduct L=-5/R=0 same sign, near-zero magnitude — sweep passes but visual defect real). For L leg to cross over R: set hipAbductL:+20 (positive=ADDUCTION=inward cross per corrected convention) and hipAbductR:-15 (negative=abduction=outward). For hands to reach the top knee: reduce shoulder abductions (-50/-62 → -25/-25, brings arms from lateral 72°/80° to ~35°); flip shoulderFwd from positive (behind) to -10 (forward, reaching knee); keep elbows ~90° (forearm comes down to knee level y~0.1). Sign conventions verified: hipAbduct + = adduction (cross), shoulderFwd + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD, leftShoulder - = raise arm up.
